value.rationale: Natural arithmetic-geometric question: incidence and flex/bitangent geometry of the explicit first nonminimal-degree plane-filling family. The novel quartic turns the rational tangent-map spectrum of degree-(q+3) curves into arithmetic of a fixed-degree, often smooth genus-three curve, giving an exact count and square-root control uniform in q. This structural bridge is not merely an easy parameter specialization, arbitrary finite-table entry, or isolated computational observation.
